cohort: 106 infants of three Asian ethnicities (Chinese, Malay, and Indian) residing in Singapore
finding: Mode of delivery, breastfeeding status, and ethnicity were identified as the main factors influencing the compositional development of the gut microbiota in infants during the first two years of life.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery significantly impacted gut microbiota diversity and the colonization of Bacteroides and Bifidobacterium genera, with effects lasting until 6 months of age.
